items.t: Workhorse Expands Canadian Dealer Network, Partners with BDS Fleet Service to Sell and Service All-electric W56 Step Vans in Ontario
items.sum: Newest dealer partner extends Workhorse’s reach across Canada Workhorse Partners with BDS Fleet Service to Sell and Service All-Electric W56 Step Vans in Ontario Workhorse’s newest Canadian dealer partner, BDS Fleet Service, operates a 60,000-square-foot Toronto facility with 61 service bays, supporting preventive maintenance, mechanical repairs, body shop services, and specialized upfitting.
